paper_title: ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction in China from 2001 to 2011 (the China PEACE-Retrospective Acute Myocardial Infarction Study): a retrospective analysis of hospital data.
rationale: The paper supports the qualitative claim that β blockers and ACE inhibitors reduce mortality in STEMI and remain underused, but the full text does not report the specific figures (58% β blockers, 66% ACE inhibitors) cited in the claim, which appear only in supplementary tables not included here.
decisive_span: However, β blockers and angiotensin-converting-enzyme inhibitors, which reduce mortality in patients with STEMI, remain very underused.

paper_title: Fusobacterium nucleatum Promotes Chemoresistance to Colorectal Cancer by Modulating Autophagy.
rationale: The paper directly demonstrates that F. nucleatum promotes CRC chemoresistance, that recurrent post-chemotherapy patients had higher F. nucleatum tumor abundance, and that F. nucleatum acts via TLR4/MYD88 innate immune signaling causing loss of specific miRNAs (miR-18a* and miR-4802).
decisive_span: Knockdown of TLR4 or MYD88 expression blocked-induced ULK1 and ATG7 upregulation,-induced miRNA-18a* and miRNA-4802 loss, and-induced chemoresistance

paper_title: A Randomized Trial of High-Flow Oxygen Therapy in Infants with Bronchiolitis.
rationale: The paper confirms HFNC "has emerged as a new method to provide respiratory support" across neonates, infants, children, and adults and was standard practice, but it does not characterize HFNC as a "mainstay of treatment in ICU/HDU settings" — indeed this trial specifically tested it outside the ICU, and the introduction notes evidence was "limited."
decisive_span:
High-flow oxygen therapy through a nasal 
cannula has emerged as a new method to pro￾vide respiratory support for respiratory diseases 
in neonates, infants, children, and adults.

paper_title: Nebulized albuterol in acute bronchiolitis.
rationale: The abstract reports a small double-blind trial showing albuterol produced significantly greater short-term improvement in clinical measures (accessory muscle score, respiratory rate, oxygen saturation), matching the "small studies...short-term improvement in clinical scores" claim; this paper is cited (ref 6-9) for that specific point, not the admission-rate claim. Assessment is from abstract only.
decisive_span: The albuterol therapy resulted in a significantly greater improvement in the accessory muscle score (decreases 0.70 vs decreases 0.30; p = 0.03), oxygen saturation (increases 0.71% vs decreases 0.47%; p = 0.01) after one dose

paper_title: Clinical transplantation of a tissue-engineered airway.
rationale: Holding population scope constant per rubric, the paper fully backs the substantive claim: a decellularized cadaveric (donor) trachea seeded with the recipient's own epithelial and MSC-derived chondrocyte cells replaced the left main bronchus. The 'young man' vs paper's 'woman' discrepancy is a population/demographic attribute scored on the separate scope axis, not substance (abstract only; confidence low).
decisive_span: We removed cells and MHC antigens from a human donor trachea, which was then readily colonised by epithelial cells and mesenchymal stem-cell-derived chondrocytes that had been cultured from cells taken from the recipient
adjudicator_note: model graded 'contradicted' (twice, incl. under a sharpened scope-constancy prompt) solely on the patient-sex descriptor. Per rubric, population/demographic mismatch (sex) is the separate scope axis, not substance; twin case A14 (same paper, correct sex) is fully-supported. Adjudicator override to fully-supported for rubric-compliance and internal consistency. Raw model grade retained in this audit note.

paper_title: Single-cell dissection of the obesity-exercise axis in adipose-muscle tissues implies a critical role for mesenchymal stem cells
rationale: This paper is a single-cell study of white adipose tissue and skeletal muscle in a mouse obesity-exercise model; it never studies brown adipose tissue (BAT), its presence in adults, or impaired BAT activity in obesity, so it cannot substantiate the claim.
decisive_span: In this study, we dissect the opposing effects of exercise training and diet-induced obesity in scWAT, vWAT, and SkM at both tissue-level and single-cell resolution.

paper_title: Varicella-zoster virus infection and immunization in the healthy and the immunocompromised host.
rationale: Only title and MeSH metadata are available, not full text or abstract. While the title and MeSH terms (Herpesvirus 3, Immune Tolerance, Neoplasms, Child) are topically consistent with VZV in immunocompromised children with cancer, they do not decisively establish the specific claim that reactivation is more common in highly immunosuppressed children receiving cancer/rheumatological therapy.

paper_title: MicroRNA-214 Affects Fibroblast Differentiation of Adipose-Derived Mesenchymal Stem Cells by Targeting Mitofusin-2 during Pelvic Floor Dysfunction in SD Rats with Birth Trauma.
rationale: The abstract concerns miR-214 targeting Mfn2 in fibroblast differentiation of ADMSCs during pelvic floor dysfunction; it says nothing about Mfn2 inhibiting VSMC proliferation, its independence from mitochondrial fusion, or rat/human Mfn2 homology (95.2%). Abstract only, so confidence is low.
decisive_span: The study provided strong evidence that miR-214 could promote fibroblast differentiation of ADMSCs by down-regulating Mfn2 to improve PFD in SD rats with birth trauma.

paper_title: Nicotinamide Riboside Preserves Cardiac Function in a Mouse Model of Dilated Cardiomyopathy.
rationale: The paper backs one part of the multi-part claim — NAMPT is depressed in human failing hearts (the reduction 'reported for patients with HFrEF') — but never characterizes NAMPT as 'the rate-limiting enzyme in the NAD+ salvage pathway,' describing it only as the enzyme converting NAM to NMN.
decisive_span: We observed a similar shift in human patients from predominant expression of NAMPT in healthy hearts to increased NMRK2 and depressed NAMPT in failing hearts
adjudicator_note: first pass recorded 'contradicted' with a self-reversing rationale (internal defect); the paper actually reports depressed NAMPT in human failing hearts, supporting the reduction element. Adjudicated to partially-supported: reduction-in-failing-hearts backed, 'rate-limiting' descriptor not in this paper.

paper_title: Dopamine oxidation mediates mitochondrial and lysosomal dysfunction in Parkinson's disease.
rationale: The paper's own discussion states verbatim that elevated mitochondrial oxidant stress in human iPSC-derived nigral DA neurons triggers a dopamine-dependent toxic cascade leading to oxidized dopamine accumulation, reduced GCase activity, lysosomal dysfunction, and α-synuclein accumulation — matching every element of the claim.
decisive_span: Here we have found that elevated mitochondrial oxidant stress in human SNc dopaminergic neurons triggers a dopamine-dependent toxic cascade leading to lysosomal dysfunction and α-synuclein accumulation – causally linking three major pathological features of PD.

paper_title: Clinical transplantation of a tissue-engineered airway.
rationale: The abstract confirms every substantive element: a 30-year-old woman with end-stage bronchomalacia received a decellularized (cells/MHC antigens removed) donor trachea colonized by epithelial cells and mesenchymal stem-cell-derived chondrocytes to replace her left main bronchus. Grading from abstract only.
decisive_span: We removed cells and MHC antigens from a human donor trachea, which was then readily colonised by epithelial cells and mesenchymal stem-cell-derived chondrocytes that had been cultured from cells taken from the recipient (a 30-year old woman with end-stage bronchomalacia). This graft was then used to replace the recipient's left main bronchus.

paper_title: β2 Adrenergic-Neurotrophin Feedforward Loop Promotes Pancreatic Cancer.
rationale: Renz et al. is cited for the β-blocker survival claim, and the paper's retrospective human cohort shows PDAC patients on nonselective β-blockers had nearly doubled median OS (40 vs 23 months), with reduced nerve density—directly backing the improved-survival and impaired-innervation elements attributed to this paper.
decisive_span: However, when we compared patients that had NSBB (propranolol, carvedilol or sotalol) to patients that had NBB, the OS was nearly doubled (40 vs. 23 months) ().

paper_title: Clinical and immunological responses in metastatic melanoma patients vaccinated with a high-dose poly-epitope vaccine.
rationale: This paper (ref 26 for "malignant diseases") is cited as one of a body of prior vectored-vaccine studies against which the citing paper's immunogenicity is compared; the abstract reports this study's own responder rates but makes no comparative claim about the citing vaccine, so it functions as a background/comparator reference. Abstract only, hence low confidence.
decisive_span: Prime-boost DNA/MVA induced Melan-A-specific CD8+ T cell responses in 22/31 (71%) patients detected by tetramer assay.

paper_title: Long non-coding RNA GAS5 sensitizes renal cell carcinoma to sorafenib via miR-21/SOX5 pathway.
rationale: The abstract confirms GAS5 acts as a competing endogenous RNA (sponge) repressing miR-21, controlling downstream SOX5, and that GAS5 overexpression confers sorafenib sensitivity — matching every element of the claim. Grading from abstract only (low confidence).
decisive_span: GAS5 overexpression conferred sorafenib sensitive to nonresponsive RCC cells, whereas knockdown of GAS5 promoted responsive RCC cells resistant to sorafenib treatment in vitro and in vivo. Mechanistically, GAS5 functioned as competing endogenous RNA to repress miR-21, which controlled its down-stream target SOX5.

paper_title: Local delivery of minocycline from metal ion-assisted self-assembled complexes promotes neuroprotection and functional recovery after spinal cord injury.
rationale: The paper directly demonstrates that local delivery achieves high neuroprotective MH concentrations in spinal cord tissue at a total dose (1.3 mg/kg) below the safe standard human dose, whereas systemic administration cannot safely reach such concentrations—exactly the claim's assertion.
decisive_span: We demonstrated that local delivery of MH at a safe human dose could expose the injured spinal cord tissue to high concentrations of MH that systemic administration cannot safely achieve

paper_title: Clinical and immunological responses in metastatic melanoma patients vaccinated with a high-dose poly-epitope vaccine.
rationale: This abstract describes an MVA-based therapeutic vaccine (MVA.Mel3) for melanoma, a non-virus-associated cancer, tested in HLA-A2-positive patients with the immunological readout focused entirely on CD8+ T cell responses to HLA.A2/A1 epitopes — matching all the claim's key features. (Abstract only; confidence low per instructions.)
decisive_span: Forty-one HLA-A2 positive patients with stage III/IV melanoma were enrolled. Patient groups received one or two doses of DNA.Mel3 followed by escalating doses of MVA.Mel3. Immunisations then continued eight weekly in the absence of disease progression. Epitope-specific CD8+ T cell responses were evaluated using ex-vivo tetramer and IFN-gamma ELISPOT assays.

paper_title: Activation of adenosine A2A receptors induces TrkB translocation and increases BDNF-mediated phospho-TrkB localization in lipid rafts: implications for neuromodulation.
rationale: The abstract shows A2A receptor activation modulates TrkB (recruitment to lipid rafts) via a PKA/Src-dependent, BDNF-independent mechanism, supporting the "src kinase dependent" and "independent of neurotrophin binding" parts; however, it demonstrates TrkB translocation/localization rather than direct transactivation (phosphorylation) of TrkB by A2A alone, and does not establish a calcium-dependent mechanism.
decisive_span: Our data demonstrate, for the first time, a BDNF-independent recruitment of TrkB receptors to lipid rafts induced by activation of adenosine A(2A) receptors, with functional consequences for TrkB phosphorylation and BDNF-induced modulation of neurotransmitter release and hippocampal plasticity.

paper_title: β2 Adrenergic-Neurotrophin Feedforward Loop Promotes Pancreatic Cancer.
rationale: The claim asserts BDNF-TrkB (NTRK2) activation reported in NSCLC (non-small-cell lung cancer) patients, but this paper is entirely about pancreatic cancer (PDAC) and does not study, mention, or report any lung cancer / NSCLC findings.
decisive_span: In contrast to the predominance of NGF in mice, BDNF was the most abundant NT in human PDAC epithelium, consistent with a previous report (). Although TrkA is the primary receptor for NGF, TrkB is the major receptor for BDNF, but importantly both of these receptors are inhibited by PLX-7486.

paper_title: Pre-clinical safety and efficacy of human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived products for autologous cell therapy in Parkinson’s Disease
rationale: The paper is precisely a preclinical development of clinical-grade iPSC lines from Parkinson's patients that raises genomic-stability and QC concerns—e.g., a Coriell-fibroblast-derived line showed compromised genomic integrity and tumorigenicity, and the authors explicitly advocate stricter genomic-integrity QC criteria amid escalating reports of genomic aberrations.
decisive_span: Despite this, we advocate for establishing standard criteria focusing on the genomic integrity of hPSC lines, given the escalating reports of genomic aberrations in both hESC and hiPSC lines.

paper_title: Return to sports activity by athletes after treatment of spondylolysis.
rationale: The claim attributes an 87.5% return-to-sport rate to Iwamoto et al with nonoperative treatment, but this abstract is a review reporting conservative-treatment return rates ranging 80.0%–89.3%; the specific 87.5% figure does not appear, and the paper is a meta-review rather than a single case series with that value.
decisive_span: The percentages of athletes who returned to sports activities ranged from 80.0% to 89.3% and from 81.9% to 100%, respectively

paper_title: Procedures for Fecal Microbiota Transplantation in Murine Microbiome Studies
rationale: The claim describes a human clinical-trial donor-screening protocol (transmissible-disease, blood, and genetic screening for parasites, C. difficile, hepatitis, syphilis, HIV, etc.), but this paper is a review of FMT procedures in murine microbiome studies; it mentions health screening only generically ("individuals delivered fresh stool one month after health screening") and provides none of the specific donor-disease screening details asserted.
decisive_span: For human donors, individuals delivered fresh stool one month after health screening (), however no specific rationale for stool collection timing was provided.

paper_title: Relationship between infant weight gain and later asthma.
rationale: The claim concerns an association of obesity and allergy; this paper studies infant weight-gain pattern and asthma outcomes (not obesity per se and not allergy broadly), and it found weight-gain pattern associated with asthma exacerbations but notably higher atopy (IgE, skin-test positivity) in the slow/decelerated group — an inverse rather than positive obesity–allergy link. It supports an obesity/weight–asthma connection but not cleanly an "obesity and allergy" positive association.
decisive_span: weight gain pattern was significantly associated with aeroallergen skin test positivity (=.03) and IgE level (=.02), with the decelerated group demonstrating the highest degree of atopy

paper_title: RNA interference-mediated USP22 gene silencing promotes human brain glioma apoptosis and induces cell cycle arrest.
rationale: The paper directly demonstrates all three parts of the claim: USP22 silencing reduced glioma cell viability, induced apoptosis, and caused cell cycle arrest.
decisive_span: USP22 gene silencing was found to inhibit human brain glioma cell replication via induction of apoptosis and cell cycle arrest

paper_title: Cancer cell autophagy, reprogrammed macrophages, and remodeled vasculature in glioblastoma triggers tumor immunity
rationale: The paper directly shows that adding anti-PD-L1 to the IM + anti-VEGF regimen significantly improved overall survival in GBM mouse models, backing the claim that combination treatment can improve anti-PD-L1 efficacy in glioblastoma.
decisive_span: Next, we enrolled animals into longer trials where anti-PD-L1 was incorporated concurrently or subsequently into the IM + anti-VEGF therapeutic regimen. We observed a significant improvement in overall survival in both cases (O).

paper_title: High Frequency of Viral Co-Detections in Acute Bronchiolitis
rationale: The claim cites this paper for a viral/viral co-infection rate of 18−34%, but the paper reports a co-detection rate of 55% in its own cohort (citing 34% and 61% from other studies as comparison range). The paper does confirm the "hospitalized for respiratory infections" caveat, but its headline co-detection figure (55%) exceeds the 18−34% range attributed to it.
decisive_span: Co-detections (2 or more viruses) were found in 55% (= 396) of samples.

paper_title: MicroRNA-214 Affects Fibroblast Differentiation of Adipose-Derived Mesenchymal Stem Cells by Targeting Mitofusin-2 during Pelvic Floor Dysfunction in SD Rats with Birth Trauma.
rationale: The abstract confirms miR-214 promotes fibroblast differentiation of ADMSCs and improves PFD in birth-trauma rats, but the mechanism is stated as down-regulating Mfn2 (its target gene), not "restoring elastin expression"; elastin was one of several upregulated markers, so the claim mischaracterizes the mechanism.
decisive_span: The study provided strong evidence that miR-214 could promote fibroblast differentiation of ADMSCs by down-regulating Mfn2 to improve PFD in SD rats with birth trauma.

paper_title: Nicotinamide Riboside Preserves Cardiac Function in a Mouse Model of Dilated Cardiomyopathy.
rationale: The claim that a similar shift (repressed NAMPT to increased NMRK2) was observed in human failing heart is directly stated in the paper's human patient data and reiterated in discussion, with GEO-database confirmation across cardiomyopathy models.
decisive_span: We observed a similar shift in human patients from predominant expression of NAMPT in healthy hearts to increased NMRK2 and depressed NAMPT in failing hearts

paper_title: Interval sentinel lymph nodes in melanoma.
rationale: The claim that lymphoscintigraphy can identify in-transit (interval) nodes between the drainage basin and primary tumor is directly backed: the paper used preoperative lymphoscintigraphy to identify interval SLNs outside traditional basins in 62 patients. Grade is from abstract only (confidence low).
decisive_span: Sentinel lymph node biopsy was guided by preoperative lymphoscintigraphy to identify all SLNs.

paper_title: The functional influences of common ABCB1 genetic variants on the inhibition of P-glycoprotein by Antrodia cinnamomea extracts.
rationale: The paper directly shows ethanolic extract of Antrodia cinnamomea fruiting bodies (EEAC) inhibits human P-gp efflux with low-µg/mL IC50 values (1.51 µg/mL for wild-type), fully backing the claim that crude ethanol extracts are potent P-gp inhibitors.
decisive_span: EEAC exhibited 2-fold lower and 4-fold lower inhibition potency toward variant-type 1236T-2677A-3435T and 1236T-2677T-3435T P-gp than toward wild-type P-gp, respectively.

paper_title: Dynamic Modulation of the Gut Microbiota and Metabolome by Bacteriophages in a Mouse Model.
rationale: The claim cites this paper to support that bacteriophages are important microorganisms in the gut community affecting health; the paper demonstrates that lytic phages modulate the gut microbiota and metabolome with implications for the mammalian host, directly backing the phage-importance claim.
decisive_span: Our results also reveal that phage predation in the gut microbiota has potential impact on the mammalian host, as manifested by modulation of the gut metabolome.
adjudicator_note: first pass: supported-with-overreach (penalized mouse-vs-human on substance axis); re-graded fully-supported holding species constant per rubric.
